text:
My analysis still points to a fee simple subject to condition subsequent, because "provided, however… may re-enter" is right-of-entry language. That isn't one of the two options in the note, so I'd flag the note as possibly mistaken. If I must choose between them, I'd pick fee simple determinable, since the future interest stays with the grantor and not a third party, which rules out the executory-interest option.

CONFIDENCE: 60
